time (closure capture bug in the Rust VM). Fix: check len(xs)
on each iteration step. No cached length to go stale.

two-top/f22e02a:
Display name: introduces "2-Top" as the user-facing name (READMEs,
apk_label, marketing). Codebase identifiers stay textual because Java
package segments and Rust crate names can't start with a digit:
repo dir is `two-top` (hyphen), Rust crate is `two_top`
(underscore), Android bundle suffix is `twotop`. The four canonical
docs, README, and CLAUDE.md now make that distinction explicit so
future readers don't refactor the wrong layer.

App crate restructure (cargo-apk needs a cdylib target):
  * crates/app/src/lib.rs — new. Extracts the prior main.rs body
    into pub fn run() plus a #[bevy_main]-annotated fn main()
    that calls run(). #[bevy_main] is a no-op on every non-android
    target; on android it generates the android_main extern that
    the system NativeActivity dlopens.
  * crates/app/src/main.rs — slimmed to a shim that calls
    app::run(). Desktop binary entry only; android skips it.
  * crates/app/Cargo.toml — adds [lib] crate-type =
    ["cdylib", "rlib"] and an explicit [[bin]] declaration so
    bin/lib pairing is unambiguous.

cargo-apk metadata in app/Cargo.toml:
  * [package.metadata.android]: package = com.ampactorlabs.twotop,
    apk_label = "2-Top", min_sdk_version = 24 (Android 7.0,
    covers commodity hardware), target_sdk_version = 34
    (Android 14, current Play Store baseline), build_targets =
    aarch64 only for now (armv7/x86_64 deferred).
  * Activity: portrait, singleTask launch mode, the standard
    config_changes set games want, exported = true (required by
    API 31+ for the launcher activity).
  * uses_permission INTERNET (forward-compat with matchbox).
  * uses_feature touchscreen required.

perennials/f2e81a1:
"USDA Hardiness zone: 5" means the plant survives zone 5 winters, so it
survives zone 6 too. transform.mjs read a bare number as a range of
exactly one zone, {min:5,max:5}, and the app believed it: zoneOk
dropped Chokecherry (recorded 1), Apple Serviceberry (3), Rose (2) and
Yucca (4) out of a zone-6 search, and the new default order demoted
them below plants nobody has measured at all. An invented bound,
printed as a fact about the plant. That is the one thing this app
does not do.

The transform stops fabricating the top and writes max: null; the
column is already nullable and round-trips. lib/hardiness.ts is now the
single place that knows what a record means, and it reads a null max
and the degenerate min===max the old data still carries as the same
sentence: nobody recorded a top, so only the floor is testable. A
recorded range is still a claim and is still honoured at both ends.
The detail page prints "USDA 5+" rather than the fabricated "5-5".

Checked against the live 8,800: 10 plants come back to a zone-6 search
and 139 across zones 1-13, with no plant lost from any zone. Chokecherry
moves from the bottom band to the first.
